source: 731 Another Good Job
target: 731 Aliud Bonum Opus

source: In the depths of the shadowy cathedral, Loki conjured a figure out of thin air.
target: In intimis umbris templi, Loki figuram ex nihilo evocavit.

source: The scene unfolding beside him was vividly reflected in the eyes of the Major Arcana card holders: Magician, Judgment, and Hermit.
target: In oculis tenentium Chartarum Arcana Maiora — Magus, Iudicium, et Eremita — scaena iuxta eum evoluta vive reflexa erat.

source: On the wall of aqueous‑black stone bricks, a painting depicted a woman in a bright red dress adorned with intricate embroidery and lace.
target: In pariete ex lateribus lapideis nigro‑aquosis, pictura repraesentabat mulierem in veste rubra nitida, ornatam intricata contextura et reticulis delicatis.

source: Her black hair was styled in an elegant high bun, and her face bore a mysterious, frozen smile.
target: Capilli eius nigri in eleganti et alta conglobatione dispositi erant, et facies eius, quasi in glacie congelata, subridens apparuit.

source: Her brown eyes seemed transfixed on the vivid, illusory ball of yarn before the Hermit and the peculiar golden lamp connected to its other end.
target: Oculi eius fusci videbantur fixi in globum vivum et illusorium filamenti, quod coram Eremita et lampade aurea insolita, ad alterum finem conexa, positum erat.

source: The woman remained within the mural, silently observing the scene.
target: Mulier in pictura mansit, tacite scaenam observans.

source: At the same time, the mature lady with a golden crown, exuding the allure of a Demoness, was pulled from the air by Loki.
target: Simul, domina provecta cum corona aurea, quae daemonis allicitatem diffundens erat, ex aere a Loki rapta est.

source: She turned her piercing blue eyes towards the Hermit, who had just entered the cathedral’s depths through the starlight door.
target: Oculos suos acutos caeruleos versus Eremitam vertit, qui modo per ianuam lucis stellaris in intimas templi partes intraverat.

source: As her long, chestnut hair billowed, each strand thickening, she too seemed fixated on the Hermit.
target: Dum capilli eius longi, castanei, undulabant atque singuli crassiores fieri videbantur, ipsa quoque in Eremitam fixa videbatur.

source: Prophesying a grim future, the Hermit quickly shielded herself with the Magic Wishing Lamp.
target: Futurum funestum praedicens, Eremita celeriter se protexit cum Lampada Magica Votiva.

source: Then, arching her back slightly, she sprouted pure white, illusory feathers reminiscent of a swan’s.
target: Deinde, leviter dorsum arcens, ex ea plumæ candidæ et illusoriae, cygno similes, emerserunt.

source: Fairytale magic, Ugly Duckling!
target: Magia fabulosa, Anas Deformis!

source: Even an ugly duckling could transform into a swan!
target: Etiam anas deformis in cygnum transformari poterat!

source: This power allowed Saints who had not yet reached the Angel level to reveal their incomplete Mythical Creature forms.
target: Haec potentia Sanctis, qui nondum ad gradum Angelicum pervenerant, permisit formas eorum creaturarum mythicarum imperfectas revelare.

source: The pristine swan feathers abruptly turned a grayish‑white and hardened into falling rocks.
target: Plumæ cygni pristinae subito in album cinereum conversæ sunt et in saxa cadentia solidatæ sunt.

source: The Hermit’s exposed skin split open, revealing grotesque, sinister crevices.
target: Cutis Eremitae exposta resoluta est, et fissuras grotescas atque sinistras revelavit.

source: Within the crevices, flesh and blood writhed, giving rise to black and white eyeballs.
target: In fissuris, caro et sanguis torquebantur, generantes oculos nigros et albos.

source: The eyeballs petrified and fell away, only to be replaced by new ones.
target: Oculi lapidei facti ceciderunt, sed deinde novi eis substituti sunt.

source: Yet, the Magic Wishing Lamp before the Hermit remained untouched.
target: Attamen, Lampada Magica Votiva coram Eremita manens intacta permanuit.

source: The black‑clad empress’s body suddenly became ethereal, her form dissipating into a torrent of knowledge that surged towards Magician, dressed in white with golden embroidery.
target: Corpus imperatricis nigro indutae subito aetherium factum est, forma eius in torrentem scientiae evanidum dissipata, qui versus Magum — albo vestitum cum contextura aurea — fluebat.

source: Magician appeared beside Loki in an instant, but a deluge of information immediately emerged from the void behind her.
target: Magus in momento iuxta Lokim apparuit, sed diluvium informationum ex vacuo post eam statim emersit.

source: Vanishing, the Magician reappeared “simultaneously” in nine different locations throughout the cathedral, her form flickering incessantly.
target: Evanescens, Magus simul in novem diversis locis per templum reapparuit, forma eius incessanter micans.

source: Upon realizing that their target was the woman in the wall painting, she attempted to escape the shadowy cathedral by force, but each effort led her back to where she began.
target: Cum intellexisset scopum suum esse mulierem in pictura parietali, illa vi effugere templum umbratile conata est, sed omnis conatus eam ad locum unde initium fecerat redduxit.

source: The black‑clad empress’s incarnation continued to pour forth information from behind the Magician’s nine figures, seeking to infiltrate the target’s mind and denying her the time to tear through the void.
target: Incarnatio imperatricis nigro indutae informationes ex novem figuris Magi continue effundebat, quaerens in mentem scopum infiltrare atque ei tempus negare ut vacuum perrumpat.

source: Smiling, Loki rose from the black wooden armchair and reached into the void with his right hand, as if grasping someone’s arm once more.
target: Subridens, Loki ex sella lignea nigra surrexit et dextro manu in vacuum protendit, quasi bracchium alicuius iterum arripiens.

source: Seizing the moment, Judgment reached the cathedral’s dome and pressed down with her right palm, like chaos descending from the heavens to the earth.
target: Momentum arripens, Iudicium ad cupolam templi pervenit et dextro palma premens, sicut chaos de caelo in terram descendens.

source: In ancient Hermes, she solemnly declared, “Mystery weakens here, while reality grows stronger!”
target: In antiquo Hermete, sollemniter declaravit: "Hic mysterium infirmatur, dum realitas roboratur!"

source: As the silver Pride Armor raced towards Overseer Perle, Franca activated the Seven‑Stone Bracelet on her left wrist.
target: Dum argenteum Indumentum Superbiæ ad Administratricem Perle properabat, Franca Bracciale Septem Lapidum in sinistro polso excitavit.

source: The crimson, blood‑like gem on the bracelet, adorned with three diamonds and four uniquely colored gems, burned with a fierce light.
target: Gemma coccinea, quasi sanguinea, in bracciale, tribus adamantibus et quattuor gemmis singulari colore ornata, luce ferocia ardebat.

source: In a flash, Franca appeared behind the Demoness of Black.
target: In momento fulgente, Franca post Demonissam Nigram apparuit.

source: She refrained from joining the Pride Armor in confronting Overseer Perle, having learned from Lumian’s encounter that their attacks would have no effect on the Overseer and only invite proportional punishment.
target: Abire conata est participare Indumento Superbiæ in oppugnatione Administratricis Perle, postquam ex congressu Lumiani didicerat impetūs eorum in Administratricem nullum effectum habere, sed tantum poenam proportionalem invitare.

source: Instead, she resolved to eliminate the Demoness of Black, a Punisher lacking godhood and exhibiting rigidity. The Demoness was merely equivalent to a stronger Sequence 5 Beyonder, making it possible for Franca to deal with her.
target: Pro eo, decrevit exterminare Demonissam Nigram, Punitricem deorum absentem et rigiditatem exhibentem. Demonissa tantum aequivalebat Beyonder Series V robustiori, ita ut Francae eam oppugnare posset.

source: As for Overseer Perle, the outcome depended on the changes and effects brought about by the Pride Armor, a Sealed Artifact devoid of “sin” and pragmatic intelligence.
target: Quoad Administratricem Perle, exitus pendebat ex mutationibus et effectibus a Indumento Superbiæ, Artefacto Sigillato, carente "peccato" et intelligentia practica.

source: Materializing, Franca raised her left hand, already adorned with the Ring of Punishment.
target: Apparens, Franca manum sinistram sustulit, iam ornata Anulo Poenae.

source: In her lake‑blue eyes, two bolts of lightning suddenly ignited and shot forth.
target: In oculis eius caeruleo‑lacustris, duo fulminis ictus subito accensi sunt et proiecerunt.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitum!

source: The Demoness of Black’s figure shattered into countless fragments.
target: Figura Demonissae Nigrae in innumerabiles fragmenta confracta est.

source: Dammit! Mirror Substitution is such a nuisance! Franca couldn’t help but curse inwardly.
target: Di immortales! Substitutio speculi tam molestia est! Franca non potuit quin interius malediceret.

source: At that instant, Lumian had just endured the punishment for attempting to escape, the flesh cloak transformed from Mr. K’s finger shattering and splattering on the ground.
target: In illo momento, Lumian modo poenam passus erat ob conatum effugiendi, cum pallium carnis, quod ex digito Domini K dissolutum et in terram sparsum erat, evenitus esset.

source: He watched as the silver‑white Pride Armor rushed to Overseer Perle’s side, raising a broadsword forged from pure light.
target: Observavit dum album argenteum Indumentum Superbiæ ad latus Administratricis Perle contendebat, gladium latum ex lumine puro fabricatum elevans.

source: Perle maintained her friendly smile, undaunted by the imposing presence of the massive, heavy armor.
target: Perle subrisum suum amicum servavit, non perturbata ingenti et gravi armaturae praesente.

source: An Overseer was impervious to attacks from those lacking godhood!
target: Administratrix impassibilis erat impetu ab iis, qui deitate caruerunt!

source: This was the sacred significance of overseeing.
target: Haec erat sacra significatio vigilantiae.

source: As for daring to strike an Overseer lifeform, the consequences would be dire!
target: Quod attinet ausum feriendi formam Administratricem, consequentia gravissima erunt!

source: Perle could already envision the armor‑like Sealed Artifact turning on the Demoness who had summoned it in the next moment.
target: Perle iam praevidere poterat Indumentum Superbiæ, Artefactum Sigillatum quasi armatura, in Demonissam, quae illud invocaverat, in momento se convertere.

source: As the Overseer contemplated this, the silver‑white Pride Armor swung the Sword of Dawn in its grasp.
target: Dum Administratrix hoc contemplabat, argentum‑album Indumentum Superbiæ Gladium Auroris in manu sua circumagerat.

source: It remained unaffected!
target: Id immotum manebat!

source: Perle’s pupils dilated as her figure in the bright red dress transformed into a pitch‑black shadow.
target: Pupillae Perle dilatarunt, dum figura eius in veste rubra nitida in umbram atra transformabatur.

source: The broadsword of light descended, cleaving the shadow in two.
target: Gladius latus ex lumine descendit, umbram in duas partes secans.

source: The divided shadows took form, replicating multiple similar shadows that scattered in all directions.
target: Umbrae divisæ formam acceperunt, replicantes plurimas umbras similes, quae in omnes partes dispersae erant.

source: The Pride Armor genuflected and drove the Sword of Dawn into the ground.
target: Indumentum Superbiæ genu flectens Gladium Auroris in terram impulit.

source: The broadsword shattered, unleashing countless sharp fragments of light that swept across the area.
target: Gladius latus confractus est, innumerabiles acutos fragmenta luminis efferens, quae per totam regionem diffusa sunt.

source: The entire quarry cave was bathed in illumination. To Franca’s surprise, the Demoness of Black, whose outline had been visible nearby, rapidly faded and vanished.
target: Totum spelunca lapicola lumine inundata est. Ad Francae stuporem, Demonissa Nigra, cuius figura prope visibilis erat, celeriter evanuit et disparuit.

source: Likewise, Jenna and Anthony, who had been cornered by the clergyman of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the Trier police incarnations, found themselves no longer under attack or pursuit.
target: Similiter, Jenna et Anthony, qui a sacerdote Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammarum et incarnationibus vigilum Trevirensium in angustum coacti erant, se iam non sub impetu aut insequentia reperere poterunt.

source: Bewildered, they observed as the Punishers, who had exerted immense pressure upon them, melted away like frost under the sun’s rays.
target: Perplexi, observaverunt, cum Punitrices, quae in eos ingentem pressionem exercuerant, quasi gelu sub radiis solis dissolutae essent.

source: Lumian was astonished by the Pride Armor’s performance.
target: Lumian de actu Indumenti Superbiæ obstupefactus est.

source: He had harbored little faith in the Sealed Artifact’s ability to challenge Overseer Perle. Yet, to his pleasant surprise, it had exceeded his expectations!
target: Parvam fidem habebat in facultate Artefacti Sigillati Administratricem Perle provocandi. Attamen, ad eius iucundam admirationem, exspectationes suas superavit!

source: Furthermore, he had noticed several peculiar details since Perle’s arrival.
target: Praeterea, complura insueta ex adventu Perle animadvertit.

source: The Overseer’s feet had not shifted an inch!
target: Pedes Administratricis ne saltem quidem unciam mutaverunt!

source: She stood beside a protruding rock with a fixed entrance to the mirror world, never pursuing or approaching. Instead, she exerted her influence upon them from a distance.
target: Stabat iuxta saxum eminens, cuius fixus introitus in mundum speculi erat, numquam insequens nec appropinquabat; potius, a longe in eos influentiam exercebat.

source: Could this be an inherent trait of an Overseer? Might the Pride Armor’s capacity to strike her stem from the abhorrence and hatred imbued within it by a deity before His demise? Were only attacks infused with godhood or a corresponding level of corruption capable of harming an Overseer? Lumian frowned, pondering these possibilities.
target: Numquid hoc esset attributum insitum Administratricis? Potuitne capacitas Indumenti Superbiæ eam feriendi oriri ex repugnatione et odio, in ea a deo ante interitum inserto, provenire? Erantne solum impetūs, deitate infusi aut corruptelae aequivalenti gradus, potentes Administratricem laedere? Lumian fronem contraxit, his possibilitatibus meditatus.

source: Snapping out of her daze, Franca shouted to him, “Moran Avigny’s makeup mirror!”
target: Ex stupore evadens, Franca ad eum exclamavit: "Speculum decori Moran Avigny!"

source: She knew that the Pride Armor could not so easily vanquish Overseer Perle. They had to seize this fleeting, uninterrupted window to escape the extraordinary mirror world.
target: Sciebat Indumentum Superbiæ Administratricem Perle non tam facile vincere posse. Illud momentaneum, sine intermissione fenestram occupare debebant, ut ex extraordinario mundo speculi effugerent.

source: Before Overseer Perle’s appearance, the dark light emanating from Moran Avigny’s makeup mirror had led Franca to suspect it might be the exit!
target: Antequam Administratrix Perle appareret, lux obscura, quae ex speculo decori Moran Avigny emanabat, Francam ad suspicandum duxit: forsitan exitum esset!

source: Franca trusted that Lumian grasped the full import of her concise words and refrained from elaborating further. The blue gem on her Seven‑Stone Bracelet emitted a sea‑like glow.
target: Franca confidebat Lumian plenam significationem verborum eius compendiosis intellexisse et ulterius non enarrasse. Gemma caerulea in Bracciale Septem Lapidum eius luce simili maris effulgebat.

source: In an instant, she materialized beside Jenna, grasping her arm.
target: In momento, apparuit juxta Jennam, bracchium eius arripiens.

source: A diamond on the Seven‑Stone Bracelet illuminated.
target: Adamans in Bracciale Septem Lapidum illuminatus est.

source: Teleport!
target: Teleporta!

source: Franca and Jenna teleported to Moran Avigny’s corpse and the nearby makeup mirror.
target: Franca et Jenna se teleportaverunt ad cadaver Moran Avigny et speculum decori prope.

source: Meanwhile, Lumian readily understood Franca’s message.
target: Interim, Lumian facile intellexit nuntium Francae.

source: He activated the black mark on his right shoulder and teleported to Anthony’s side. Without hesitation, he grabbed his teammate’s arm and teleported once more.
target: Marcum nigrum in dextro umero suo activavit et ad latus Anthoni teleportavit; sine mora, bracchium sodalis sui arripuit et iterum teleportavit.

source: Their destination: Moran Avigny’s already open makeup mirror!
target: Destinatio eorum: speculum decori Moran Avigny, iam apertum!

source: However, upon appearing near Moran Avigny’s corpse, Franca and Lumian were stunned to discover that the makeup mirror had become illusory and unreal, as if it were a mere projection of the original item.
target: Sed, cum prope cadaver Moran Avigny apparuerunt, Franca et Lumian stupefacti sunt, cum invenerunt speculum decori illusorium et irréale factum esse, quasi tantum proiectio rei originalis.

source: At that moment, they heard Overseer Perle’s voice once again.
target: In illo momento, vocem Administratricis Perle iterum audiverunt.

source: “You stand guilty! You have harmed an Overseer!”
target: «Culpabiles estis! Administratricem laesistis!»

source: As her voice echoed, the silver‑white full‑body armor ascended, and the void behind it ruptured into darkness.
target: Dum vox eius resonabat, armatura integra, album argenteum, ascendit, et vacuum post eam in tenebras ruptum est.

source: Propelled by an unseen force, the Pride Armor plummeted into a centipede‑like crack resembling a void scar, falling into a pitch‑black abyss that extended as far as the eye could see. It vanished entirely from Lumian and his companions’ sight.
target: Vi invisibili impulsum, Indumentum Superbiæ in fissuram centipedem similem, quae vestigium vacui alludebat, demersum est in abyssum atrum, quod usque ad oculum se extendebat; omnino a conspectu Lumiani et sociorum eius evanuit.

source: Judgment: Exile!
target: Iudicium: Exsilium!

source: Fragmented shadows swiftly converged beside the protruding rock with the fixed entrance to the mirror world. Overseer Perle, garbed in her red dress, reappeared.
target: Umbrae confractae celeriter iuxta saxum eminens, cuius fixus introitus in mundum speculi erat, convenere. Administratrix Perle, in veste rubra induta, reapparuit.

source: Holding a makeup mirror in her hand, she smiled and said, “Did you believe I would leave the exit intact? I replaced it with a counterfeit long ago!”
target: Tenens speculum decori in manu, subridens dixit: "Credidistisne me exitum intactum relinquere? Illud olim falsum substitui!"

source: Lumian, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony’s expressions shifted slightly.
target: Expressiones Lumiani, Francae, Jennae, et Anthoni leviter mutatae sunt.

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian, already grasping Anthony’s arm, swiftly activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
target: Dum haec cogitationes per mentem eius cursu agerent, Lumian, iam bracchium Anthoni arripiens, celeriter marcum nigrum in dextro umero suo activavit.

source: He and Anthony vanished in an instant beside Moran Avigny’s corpse.
target: Ipse et Anthony in uno momento iuxta cadaver Moran Avigny evanuerunt.

source: Franca made a similar effort, causing the emerald in her Seven‑Stone Bracelet to emit a transparent green light.
target: Franca similem conatum fecit, ita ut smaragdus in Bracciale Septem Lapidum eius lucem viridem transparens emiit.

source: However, just as she Blinked with Jenna to a corner of the quarry cave, Perle’s Words of Order resounded in her ears.
target: Attamen, mox cum ipsa et Jenna ad angulum speluncae lapicola teleporterentur, verba ordinationis Perle in auribus eius resonaverunt.

source: “You stand guilty! You attacked an Overseer!”
target: «Culpabiles estis! Administratricem oppugnastis!»

source: Franca was the one who had unleashed the Pride Armor!
target: Franca ipsa erat quae Indumentum Superbiæ liberaverat!

source: As Franca prepared to use the Seven‑Stone Bracelet to depart her current location, she suddenly witnessed the surrounding void freeze and transform into layers of amber, encasing her and Jenna within.
target: Dum Franca parabat Bracciale Septem Lapidum ad locum suum currentem relinquendum uti, subito vidit vacuum circumstantem congelari ac in stratis ambra mutari, quae eam et Jennam inclusit.

source: This was a “cage” from which even teleportation could not provide escape.
target: Hoc erat "cavea", ex qua etiam teleportatio effugere non poterat.

source: It encompassed the entire area, and even if Franca and Jenna attempted to employ Mirror Substitution, they would remain confined within its boundaries.
target: Totum spatium complectebat, et etiam si Franca et Jenna speculum substitutionis uti conarentur, intra eius limites manere deberent.

source: Judgment: Confinement!
target: Iudicium: Confinatio!

source: Overseer Perle averted her gaze, searching for Lumian and Anthony.
target: Administratrix Perle oculos avertit, Lumian et Anthoni quaerens.

source: She surveyed the surroundings but found no trace of the two.
target: Circumiecta inspexit, sed nullum vestigium duorum invenit.
